snippet.title: Arctic Grave | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
After a (relatively) long development I'm excited to announce the release date for Arctic Grave! And what better time to do so for a horror game than Ocober 31, right?

Uncover the mystery of an arctic cargo outpost's lost crew in this horror game. Take in the frozen sea and delve into the depths of the facility, finding items and uncovering new paths with each one to learn what really happened here. But be careful, because something else might be here with you.

Wishlist the game on Steam so you don't miss the release: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4258680/Arctic_Grave/
